answer: Deposits are visible in knoll, and ember reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 61 aliases, and each one needs its own funded ripple account. A bond of 27% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. A farm of 1355 identities would post 2993 proofs and burn roughly 89 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
